Subject: Access trail raw dump & handoff for SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this — Acme Health is preparing for a SOC 2 Type II readiness review and we need a full extract of operator/admin activity (access trail) for the period 2025-01-01 through 2026-06-30. The auditor is asking for:

- Raw event records (not aggregated) with fields: timestamp, actor_id, actor_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, user_agent, request_id, request_payload_ref, response_status, kv_cache_key (if applicable), session_id
- UTC-normalized timestamps and timezone metadata
- A signed manifest (HMAC or PGP) and SHA256 checksums for each file
- Delivery via SFTP (preferred) or pre-signed URL; we will provide a temp SFTP endpoint
- Chain-of-custody notes (who extracted, checksum verification steps) for auditor evidence

Can Redwood provide a sample export (schema + one-day sample) and a recommended handoff checklist? Also call out any fields that are redacted by default or that require a special export flag.

We are on a tight timeline — auditor wants the bundle by 2026-07-20. Please let me know feasibility and what you need from our side.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Grant
Senior Compliance Manager
Acme Health

Attachments: request_summary.pdf (pdf, referenced)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: Access trail raw dump & handoff for SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We're able to support a raw export with the fields you listed; we just need to confirm a couple of details internally and with you:

1) Delivery: SFTP is fine. Please share the endpoint, username, and preferred auth method (password vs. key). If you prefer pre-signed URLs we can provide time-limited signed objects instead.
2) Redaction: by default we do not redact event-level records unless a customer requests PII redaction. Please confirm if you want email addresses redacted or tokenized in the export.
3) Manifest/signing: we support generating a manifest.csv and can HMAC-SHA256 sign it. If you require PGP signatures or hardware-backed keys (HSM), let us know.
4) Timezone: we will normalize to UTC in the export and include original timezone metadata when available.
5) Timeline: internal ETA is typically 3 business days for a full 18-month slice. If you need expedited delivery we can prioritize (may require an exception).

I'm looping in Kimberly (Security & Compliance) and Marcus (Platform exports) to confirm the exact export path, schema file, and custody notes.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Alicia / Neha — quick tech note and proposed handoff flow from Platform: 

Export format and schema:
- We will produce JSONL files compressed with gzip (filename pattern: access_trail_YYYYMMDD_UTC.jsonl.gz).
- Each record will be a flat JSON object containing the fields you requested. Schema (sample_export_schema.json) attached.
- We will normalize timestamps to UTC and include an original_tz field when available.

Manifest and signing:
- We will produce a manifest CSV (manifest_template.csv) with file name, size_bytes, sha256_hex, record_count, generated_at, exported_by.
- Default signing: HMAC-SHA256 using a per-customer key managed in our KMS. If Acme requires an external PGP signature or HSM-stored key, indicate and we will escalate.

Delivery options and custody:
- SFTP upload (preferred): we can push to your host over SFTP (SCP not recommended). We support key-based auth; we will provide our public key and a manifest signed by HMAC.
- Alternative: temporary signed object URLs on your cloud bucket (AWS S3 presigned PUT/GET).
- Chain-of-custody: extraction job record (who ran it, run id), manifest checksums, server-side logs, and a short handoff statement we will include as handoff_statement.txt.

PII / redaction:
- By default actor_email is included. If you require tokenization/redaction, we need to run a scrub step which will add ~1 business day to ETA and reduce fidelity for matching.

ETA and next steps:
- If you provide SFTP credentials or presigned upload target and confirm no PII redaction, we can deliver the bundle by EOD 2026-07-17 (3 business days).
- Attachments: sample_export_schema.json, manifest_template.csv (attached).

Marcus, please confirm run id prefix and if there are any throttling constraints to call out for a large multi-month export.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_export_schema.json (application/json), manifest_template.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — that all looks good. We will: 
- Provide an SFTP endpoint with key-based auth by EOD today (credentials to follow in a separate secure message).
- Confirm no PII redaction required for this auditor review.
- Request HMAC-SHA256 manifest is acceptable (no PGP required).

One ask from our auditor: can Redwood include a short chain-of-custody statement in the bundle (who executed export, checksums verified by whom, and timestamps of verification)? We need a signed PDF or plain text file that can be included in the evidence pack.

If you can commit to the 2026-07-17 delivery, we'll mark the request as high priority. Please reply with a one-line confirmation of the ETA and whether there are any rate limits we should be aware of while you run the extract.

Best,
Alicia
